rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Diário do Congresso Nacional reproduces the Superior Electoral Court's diploma, dated Brasília 12 December 2022 and signed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes as President, stating that by the will of the people expressed at the polls on 30 October 2022 Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, candidate of the Brasil da Esperança coalition, was elected President of the Federative Republic of Brazil, and qualifying him for investiture before the National Congress on 1 January 2023.
